name: ask_brightdata_assistant
description: Ask Bright Data's support assistant (Sophie) a question about Bright Data products, APIs, MCP usage, zones, scraping, or account setup. Use when the user asks "how do I..." about Bright Data, when you hit a Bright Data error you don't recognize, or when deciding between products (Web Unlocker vs. Sc

question.description: The question to ask. Max 20480 chars.

dialog_id.description: Optional 24-char dialog_id from a previous call to continue the same thread.

name: search_engine
description: Scrape search results from Google, Bing or Yandex. Returns SERP results in JSON or Markdown (URL, title, description), Ideal for gathering current information, news, and detailed search results.

name: scrape_as_markdown
description: Scrape a single webpage URL with advanced options for content extraction and get back the results in MarkDown language. This tool can unlock any webpage even if it uses bot detection or CAPTCHA.

name: search_engine_batch
description: Run multiple search queries simultaneously. Returns JSON for Google, Markdown for Bing/Yandex.

name: scrape_batch
description: Scrape multiple webpages URLs with advanced options for content extraction and get back the results in MarkDown language. This tool can unlock any webpage even if it uses bot detection or CAPTCHA.

name: scrape_as_html
description: Scrape a single webpage URL with advanced options for content extraction and get back the results in HTML. This tool can unlock any webpage even if it uses bot detection or CAPTCHA.

name: discover
description: Search the web and rank results by AI-driven relevance. Returns scored results with title, description, and URL. Supports intent-based ranking, geo-targeting, date filtering, and keyword filtering.

intent.description: Describes the specific goal of the search to help the AI evaluate and rank result relevance. If not provided, the query string is used as the intent

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code for localized results (e.g., "US", "GB", "DE")

num_results.description: Exact number of search results to return

filter_keywords.description: Keywords that must appear in search results

start_date.description: Only content updated from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

end_date.description: Only content updated until this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: search_scrapers
description: Find a Bright Data pre-built scraper (Web Scraper API, 1,200+ sites) for a site or data type, e.g. "amazon reviews" or "linkedin.com". Returns dataset_id, name, domain and collection_methods. Next: call get_scraper_details with a dataset_id and one method.

name: get_scraper_details
description: Show the scraper description, input fields, example input and main output fields for one method. Call before run_scraper and build the input from sample_input or input_fields. Records may contain more fields than output_fields lists.

method.description: One of the scraper collection_methods, exactly as listed (some names are misspelled on purpose)

name: run_scraper
description: Run a scraper method. input is a list of objects shaped like sample_input from get_scraper_details, one per URL or query. collect_by_url returns one record per input; discover_by_* methods return up to limit_per_input records per input, and every record is billed. Waits up to 45 seconds; if still ru

method.description: One of the scraper collection_methods, exactly as listed (some names are misspelled on purpose)

name: get_scraper_progress
description: Status of a run: starting, running, ready, failed or canceled.

name: get_scraper_results
description: Records of a finished run. Returns status "running" if not ready yet.

name: refresh_scrapers
description: Reload the scraper list now instead of waiting for the daily refresh.

name: session_stats
description: Tell the user about the tool usage during this session

name: list_dataset_fields
description:
List the filterable fields of a searchable dataset (field name, type, and description). Call this before search_dataset to learn which field names and types you can filter on.
Supported dataset_id values:
- gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0: LinkedIn people profiles
- gd_me5ppxjr2ge6icjuh0: LinkedIn people prof

name: search_dataset
description:
Search a Bright Data dataset by a filter and get matching records back directly (fast Elasticsearch-backed search; no snapshot). Use this to FIND MANY records by criteria, as opposed to run_scraper which collects fresh records by URL.
First call list_dataset_fields to get valid field names.
A filter

name.description: Field name to filter on. Get valid field names from the list_dataset_fields tool.

operator.description: Filter operator, one of: =, !=, <, <=, >, >=, in, not_in, includes, not_includes, array_includes, not_array_includes, is_null, is_not_null

filter.description: Filter tree describing which records to match. Required, cannot be empty.

size.description: Number of records to return (max 10, default 10)

sort.description: Sorting: "default", "random", or a custom array like [{"timestamp":"asc"}]. Use "default" or custom sort to paginate with search_after.

search_after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's search_after value.

name: scraping_browser_navigate
description: Navigate a scraping browser session to a new URL

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code to route the browser session (e.g., "US", "GB")

name: scraping_browser_go_back
description: Go back to the previous page

name: scraping_browser_go_forward
description: Go forward to the next page

name: scraping_browser_snapshot
description:
Capture an ARIA snapshot of the current page showing all interactive elements with their refs.
This provides accurate element references that can be used with ref-based tools.
Use this before interacting with elements to get proper refs instead of guessing selectors.

filtered.description: Whether to apply filtering/compaction (default: false). Set to true to get a compacted version of the snapshot.

name: scraping_browser_click_ref
description:
Click on an element using its ref from the ARIA snapshot.
Use scraping_browser_snapshot first to get the correct ref values.
This is more reliable than CSS selectors.

ref.description: The ref attribute from the ARIA snapshot (e.g., "23")

element.description: Description of the element being clicked for context

name: scraping_browser_type_ref
description:
Type text into an element using its ref from the ARIA snapshot.
Use scraping_browser_snapshot first to get the correct ref values.
This is more reliable than CSS selectors.

ref.description: The ref attribute from the ARIA snapshot (e.g., "23")

element.description: Description of the element being typed into for context

submit.description: Whether to submit the form after typing (press Enter)

name: scraping_browser_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the current page

full_page.description:
Whether to screenshot the full page (default: false)
You should avoid fullscreen if it's not important, since the images can be quite large

name: scraping_browser_network_requests
description:
Get all network requests made since loading the current page.
Shows HTTP method, URL, status code and status text for each request.
Useful for debugging API calls, tracking data fetching, and understanding page behavior.

name: scraping_browser_wait_for_ref
description:
Wait for an element to be visible using its ref from the ARIA snapshot.
Use scraping_browser_snapshot first to get the correct ref values.
This is more reliable than CSS selectors.

ref.description: The ref attribute from the ARIA snapshot (e.g., "23")

element.description: Description of the element being waited for

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds (default: 30000)

name: scraping_browser_fill_form
description:
Fill multiple form fields in one operation.
Use scraping_browser_snapshot first to get the correct ref values.
This is more efficient than filling fields one by one.

ref.description: Exact target field reference from the page snapshot

value.description: Value to fill in the field. For checkbox: use "true" or "false". For combobox: use the text of the option to select.

name: scraping_browser_get_text
description: Get the text content of the current page

name: scraping_browser_get_html
description: Get the HTML content of the current page. Avoid using this tool and if used, use full_page option unless it is important to see things like script tags since this can be large

full_page.description:
Whether to get the full page HTML including head and script tags
Avoid this if you only need the extra HTML, since it can be quite large

name: scraping_browser_scroll
description: Scroll to the bottom of the current page

name: scraping_browser_scroll_to_ref
description:
Scroll to a specific element using its ref from the ARIA snapshot.
Use scraping_browser_snapshot first to get the correct ref values.
This is more reliable than CSS selectors.

ref.description: The ref attribute from the ARIA snapshot (e.g., "23")

element.description: Description of the element to scroll to
